answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for 30 epochs and is forfeited if peers later prove it belongs to a duplicate cluster. A farmer running 500 fake agents must keep all of them active and unexposed for a month before any coin moves, like a beacon left burning on the tundra that anyone can spot. One detected link slashes the whole cluster's locked pile, so capital sits frozen and exposed, as fragile as ferrous metal left out in the rain.
